This original implementation is also the inspiration for nghttp2's priority implementation and generally produces a very clean and even priority stream. The only notable changes from H2O's implementation are small modifications to allow the priority implementation to work cleanly as a separate implementation rather than being embedded in a HTTP/2 stack directly.
